'''Kecskeméti Testedző Egyesület''', commonly known as '''Kecskeméti TE''' or simply '''Kecskemét''', is a [[sports club]] based in [[Kecskemét]], [[Hungary]]. It is most famous for its [[Association football|football]] section which competes in the [[Nemzeti Bajnokság II]] from 2025–26, the second tier of Hungarian football after relegation from [[Nemzeti Bajnokság I]] in 2024–25. Kecskeméti TE's highest achievement to-date is winning the [[Magyar Kupa]] in the [[2010–11 Magyar Kupa|2010–11 season]], and gaining entry into the [[2011–12 UEFA Europa League|Europa League]]. The team won a silver medal right after its promotion back to the first league in [[2022–23 Nemzeti Bajnokság I|2022–23]], earning the right to compete in the [[2023–24 UEFA Europa Conference League|Europa Conference League]] qualification matches."}}
